question: What do unstructured 3D local particles do when the reacting fuel/waste molecules must diffuse and meet the macromolecule, and only declared reservoir contacts exchange material?
reason: Previous worlds impose uniform fuel activities and cannot test gradients, finite fuel capacity or steric access of reactants. This world explicitly tracks fuel and waste, rather than adding an inside/outside protection coefficient.

law.lattice: periodic cubic molecular lattice, spacing1, kBT1; one physical particle per site; empty is implicit solvent
law.species: B/I conformations of a conserved neutral macromolecule; F/W conformations of a second conserved fuel moiety. Equal lattice exclusion size is a coarse-grained assumption, not a calibrated real size ratio.
law.Hamiltonian: H=df*N_B+epsilon*N_BB, B-B nearest-neighbor contacts once; F/W have equal on-site energies0 and no contact affinity in this first variant
law.driven: B_i+F_j<->I_i+W_j only for neighboring i,j; forward coefficient eta*exp((epsilon-epsilon_ts)*nB_i+df)/(2d), reverse eta*exp(-epsilon_ts*nB_i)/(2d). No global mu appears in a local reaction rate.
law.transition_state: epsilon_ts=.5*epsilon, a declared local saddle contact energy; all forward/reverse ratios equal exp(-DeltaH) for the actual occupied neighbor pair
law.diffusion: hop to an empty nearest-neighbor site; total bare D_state times exp(epsilon*nB_source) for B, bare D_state for I/F/W; reverse ratio exp(-DeltaH)
law.reservoir: At declared contact sites only, empty->F/W at kex*zF/W; F/W->empty at kex. Macromolecules never enter or leave. zF+zW=.25, log(zF/zW)=mu. Chemical potentials muF=log zF, muW=log zW. Source terms are explicit exchanges, never unaccounted generation.
law.source_geometry: plane means all x=0 sites in the periodic volume contact an external reservoir sheet; uniform means all sites contact reservoirs with kex/N so total baseline exchange attempt capacity matches the plane; closed means kex0. Environment geometry is PLACED and never interpreted as an emergent body location.
law.energy_entropy: Chemical work enters only through reservoir exchanges: work=muF*(F_in-F_out)+muW*(W_in-W_out). Independently accumulate local log forward/reverse rate ratios for hops, reactions and reservoir contacts. Generalized medium entropy flow*kBT equals work-(H-H0); not calorimetry for identified fuel molecules.
law.finite_fuel: With closed contacts the unequal initial F/W composition is a placed finite chemical free-energy resource. Its mixing entropy, not a hidden perpetual source, can drive transient conversion. No refill occurs unless a reservoir contact event is explicitly counted.
approximations: implicit overdamped isothermal solvent, no momentum or hydrodynamics
hypothetical contact, saddle, drag and encounter coefficients
no identified reaction chemistry, actual enthalpy or continuum membrane prediction

initial: Uniformly random macro positions without replacement, half B. Of the remaining sites, exactly round(.2*(V-M)) contain uniformly random F/W particles, with F fraction logistic(mu). Thus all diffusion/source controls at the same mu share the identical unstructured initial configuration. All particle kinds and prepared reservoir activities are placed. No bags, spheres, interfaces or closed surfaces are seeded.
known_equilibrium_controls: At zF=zW, the grand-canonical equilibrium has macro weights exp(-H), fuel states on nonmacro sites proportional to 1,zF,zW; two-macro exact enumeration and fuel count moments are available independently.

With passive pathway absent and constant reservoirs, a configurational equilibrium control has effective macro energy df+mu because B->I also converts F->W. This is V, not a fuel-maintenance discovery.
Closed fuel has fixed moiety counts and no external chemical work; unequal initial fuel composition must not be called autonomous metabolism.
validation_first: independent species, macro identity, neighbor and B-pair counts at every sample
all four stoichiometric count equations and reservoir in/out ledger
exact tiny 3D macro canonical distribution and grand-canonical fuel moments at equal activities
same-seed complete-state determinism and matched ICs across source/diffusion controls
numerics: Exact kinetic Monte Carlo with local event propensities; auxiliary per-species bounds and clock may be globally implemented, with no global physical force, oracle, geometry label or adaptive physical parameter. No finite integration dt, clipping, mass repair or target-based stopping.

discovery.cases: all twenty, 60 histories after validation; never stop or omit a case based on its appearance

readouts: B/I/F/W x profiles and reservoir contact fluxes, without aligning a body to the imposed source sheet
local passive/driven net reaction and particle hops
molecule-region density, periodic volumes and topology limitations
fuel/waste distributions and actual encounter availability, not inferred protective coefficients

verification: Freeze all60 outcomes before selecting matched holdouts and larger/longer worlds; preregister next selection. N is physical molecular volume, not continuum resolution. No 2D result substitutes for 3D.
qualification: Original three genuinely distinct controlled findings contract unchanged. Known equilibrium reproduction, fuel consumption, source-aligned structure by itself, input molecule types, reactant-rate algebra and multiple parameter settings of one instability do not fill the quota. No membrane/life/rung claim without physical material, interior/transport and resolution evidence.
no_touch: all v01/v02 lattice code and results
